m: सं-√ 1. हा Ā. -जिहीते, (pr. p. -जिहान), to rise up, RV.; Br.; GṛŚrS.; to move about, BhP.; to obtain, Nalod.
सं-√ 2. हा P. -जहाति, to leave together, Āpast.; to give up, abandon, MBh. : Desid. -जिहासति, to wish to leave or desert, Car.
सं-हान mfn. narrow, MaitrS.

s: puM, (saMhriyate'neneti । saM + hf + “aDyAyanyAyeti .” 3 । 3 । 122 । iti GaYantaH sADuH .) narakaviSezaH । ityamaraH ॥ pralayaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 1 । 80 । “manvantarARyasaMKyAni sargaH saMhAra eva ca । kAqavivEtat kurute paramezWI punaH punaH ॥”) makzepaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ saMharaRaYca ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 5 । 57 । “saMmohanaM nAma saKe ! mamAstraM prayAgama hAraviBaktamantram ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + hf--GaY । 1 pralaye hemaca॰ 2 gISe 3 saMkzape 4 narakaBede amaraH । 5 vitarjane 6 kAsikABEravaBeda pf jawA॰ । “asitANgoruruScaRqaH kroDa unmatta eva ca । kapAlI BIzaRaScEva saMhAraScAzwa BEravAH” tantrasA॰ ।
m: सं-हार -रक &c. See सं-√ हृ.
सं-हार m. bringing together, collection, accumulation, MBh.
contraction (of the organs of speech, opp. to वि-हार, q.v.), RPrāt.
drawing in (of an elephant's trunk), Ragh.
binding together (of hair; cf. वेणी-स्˚), MBh.
fetching back (an arrow after its discharge by magical means), MBh.; R.; Pur. (cf. IW. 402 n. 1)
abridgment, comprehensive description, a compendium, manual, Lāṭy.
destruction (esp. the periodical des˚ of the universe at end of a Kalpa), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a destroyer (= संहर्तृ), MBh. xiv, 1577
end, conclusion (of a drama or of an act of a drama), Bhar.; Sāh. &c.
a division of the infernal regions, L.
N. of an Asura (v.l. सं-ह्राद), Hariv.
practice, skill, W.
a: संहारः — 1 Drawing or bringing together, collecting; अनुभवनु वेणीसंहारमहोत्सवं Ve. 6. --2 Contraction, compression, abridgment. --3 Withholding, drawing back, withdrawal (opp. प्रयोग or विक्षेप); प्रयोगसंह रविभक्तमंत्रं R. 5. 57, 45. --4 Restraining, holding back. --5 Destruction, especially of the universe, universal destruction. --6 Close, end, conclusion. --7 An assemblage, a group. --8 A fault in pronunciation. --9 A charm or spell for withdrawing magical weapons. --10 Practice, skill. --11 A division of hell. --Comp. --भैरवः one of the forms of Bhairava. --मुद्रा N. of a particular posture in the Tantra worship; it is thus defined:-- अवोमुखे वामहस्ते ऊर्ध्वास्यं दक्षहस्तकं . क्षिप्तांगुलीरंगुलीभिः संगृह्य परिवर्तयेत्.

m: सं-हार—भैरव m. Bhairava as world-destroyer (one of the 8 forms of Bh˚ q.v.), Cat.
सं-हार—बुद्धि-मत् mfn. intending to destroy the world, Hariv.
सं-हार—कालाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते to appear like the time of the des˚ of the w˚, Śukas.
सं-हार—काल m. the time of the des˚ of the world, MBh.
सं-हार—कारिन् mfn. causing universal destruction, Pañcat.
सं-˚हारक mfn. (cf. अस्थि-स्˚) drawing together, compressing, closing, MW.
destructive, ruinous, ib.
a destroyer, ib.
a: संहारक — a. 1 Destructive. --2 Compressing, contracting, closing.

s: strI, (saMhArasya mudrA .) visarjjanamudrA । yaTA, rAGavaBawwaDftam । “aDomuKe vAmahaste UrdDvAsyaM dakzahastakam । kziptANgulIraNgulIBiH saMgfhya parivarttayet । proktA saMhAramudreyamarpaRe tu praSasyate ॥” arpaRe AtmanIti SezaH । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥ BEravaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “asitANgo ruruScaRqaH kroDa unmatta eva ca । kapAlI BIzaRaScEva saMhArAScAzwa BEravAH ॥” iti tantram ॥

v: strI saMhArArTA visarjanArTA mudrA । tantrokte mudrABede tallakzaRam “aDomuKe vAmahaste UrdDvAsyaM dakzahastakam । kziptvANgulIraNgalIBiH saMgfhya parivarttayet । proktA saMhAramudrEvamarpaRe tu praSasyate” padArTA॰ DftavAkyam । arpaRe Atmani devArzaRe” ti॰ ta॰ ।
m: सं-हार—मुद्रा f. N. of a partic. posture in the Tantra worship (= विसर्जन-मुद्रा), MW.
सं-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Daś.
सं-हार—वेग-वत् mfn. ardently wishing to destroy the world, MBh.
सं-˚हारिक mfn. all-destroying, Hcat.
सं-˚हारिन् mfn. destroying (ifc.), Kathās.
सं-हार्य mfn. to be brought or drawn together or collected (from various places), ŚāṅkhBr.; ŚrS.
to be transported, transportable, PañcavBr.; ŚrS.
to be avoided, TĀr.
to be removed or checked or restrained (in अ-स्˚), MBh.; R.
to be led astray or corrupted (in अ-स्˚), ib.
to be made to partake of, one who has a claim on (abl.), MBh.
सं-हात m. (for सं-घात, which is often v.l.) conciseness (in, अक्षर-स्˚), Sāh.
N. of a partic. hell, Mn. iv, 89
of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
a: संहातः — One of the 21 hells; Ms. 4. 89.

m: सं-हात्य n. (v.l. सं-घात्य) violation of an alliance (by means of persuasion or bribery, or by the operation of fate), Sāh.
सं-हाय्यम् ind. being able to rise (in अ-स्˚), PañcavBr.

s: strI, (saM + hve + ktin .) bahuBiH kftAhvAnam । ityamaraH ॥
v: strI sam + hveY--ktin । bahumiH kfte AhvAne amaraH ।
m: सं-हूति See सम्-√ ह्वे.
सं-हूति f. shouting or calling out together, general shout or clamour, L.
a: संहूतिः — f. General shout, loud uproar, tumultuous exultation.

k.v: आख्याह्वे अभिधानं च नामधेयं च नाम च। हूतिकारणाह्वानं संहूतिर्बहुभिः कृता॥

m: सं-ह (prob. = सं-घ) in comp.

सं-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, (ind.p. -हत्य, q.v.), to strike or put together, join, shut, close (eyes, wings, hands), RV. &c. &c.; to beat together, make solid, Suśr.; to put together i.e. frame, fabricate, ŚāṅkhŚr.; (Ā.) to rush together (in battle), meet, encounter (instr.), RV. vii, 56, 22; (जिघ्नते), to meet as a friend (instr.), ib. ix, 14, 4; (P.) to break, crush, kill, destroy, ib. : Pass. -हन्यते, to be put together or joined, join, unite (intr.), Śaṃk.; to become compact or solid, ŚBr. : Caus. -घातयति, to strike together, kill, destroy utterly, MW.
a: संहन् — {c2c} P. 1 To unite closely together, join together; हस्तौ संहत्य Ms. 2. 71; दूत एव हि संधत्तं भिनत्त्येव च संहतान् 7. 66; see संहत. --2 To heap, collect, accumulate. --3 To contract, diminish. --4 To strike, kill, destroy. --5 To strike against each other, clash.

m: सं-˚हननीय mfn. compact, solid, firm, strong, MBh.

s: klI, (saMhanyate iti । saM + hana + lyuw .) SarIram । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgatate । 5 । 2 । 21 । “AgnIDrasutAste mAturanugraRAdOtpattikenEva saMhananabalopetAH pitrA viBaktA AtmatulyanAnAmi yaTAviBAgaM jambUdbIpavarzARi buBujuH ॥” samyagGAtanaYca ॥ (kaWine, tri । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 9 । 10 । “SItozRavAtavarzezu vfza ivAnADftANgaH pInaH saMhananANgaH * * * vicacAra ॥” “saMhanyante niviqIBavanti aNgAni yasya । kaWinAvayava ityarTaH ॥” iti tawwIkAyAM svAmI ॥)
v: na॰ saMhanyate parArTaM saMsrajyate sam + hana--lyuw । 1 dehaM amaraH 2 saNGAte 3 baDe ca ।
m: सं-हनन mfn. compact, solid, firm, MBh.; BhP.
making compact or solid, Suśr.
striking together, MW.
killing, destroying, a destroyer, ib.
सं-हनन m. N. of a son of Manasyu, MBh.
सं-हनन n. the act of striking together, Suśr.
hardening, ib.
solidity, compactness, robustness, strength, muscularity, MBh.; R. &c.
firmness, steadfastness, Śīl.
junction, connection (in अ-स्˚), Nīlak.
agreement, harmony, MBh.
the body (as having the limbs well compacted), L.
a mail-coat (?), L.
rubbing the limbs, W.
a: संहननं — 1 Compactness, firmness. --2 The body, person; अमृताध्मातजीमूतस्निग्धसंहतनस्य ते U. 6. 21; Mv. 2. 46. --3 Strength; see संहति also. --4 Rubbing the limbs. --5 Killing.

k.v: अङ्गं प्रतीकोऽवयवोऽपघनोऽथ कलेवरम्. गात्रं वपुः संहननं शरीरं वर्ष्म विग्रहः॥

m: सं-हनन—बलोपेत mfn. endowed with firmness and strength, BhP.
सं-हनन—वत् mfn. strongly built, muscular, robust, Jātakam.
सं-हन˚नोपेत mfn. endowed with strength or muscularity, MBh.
सं-हन्तृ mfn. one who joins or unites, Śaṃk.
सं-हन्˚त्री (˚त्री), f. a female destroyer, Pañcar. (perhaps w.r. for सं-हर्त्री)
सं-हनु mfn. striking the jaws together, AV.
सं-हनु ind. (with √ कृ) to seize between the jaws, ib.

s: puM, (saMhara iti AKyA yasya .) pAvakanAmAgniH । iti matsyapurARam ॥
m: सं-ह˚राख्य m. N. of Agni Pavamāna, MatsyaP.
सं-हर , ˚रण. See सं-√ हृ.
सं-हर m. drawing together, contracting, MW.
destroying, ib.
N. of an Asura, Hariv.
सं-हरण n. drawing or bringing together, collecting, gathering, MBh.
binding together, arranging (accord. to others ‘cutting’, of hair), Āpast.
taking hold of, seizure, MBh.
fetching back (arrows &c. discharged by magical arts), Uttarar.
destroying, destruction (opp. to ‘creation’), MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.
a: संहरणं — 1 Gathering, bringing together, collecting. --2 Taking, seizing. --3 Contracting. --4 Restraining. --5 Destroying, ruining. --6 Withdrawing.

m: सं-हर्तव्य mfn. to be drawn together or collected, Hariv.
to be re-arranged or restored, Sāh.
to be destroyed, Nīlak.
सं-˚हर्तृ mfn. one who draws together or contracts, MW.
one who destroys, a destroyer, MBh.; R. &c.
a: संहर्तृ — m. A destroyer.

s: puM, (saM + hfza + GaY .) pramodaH । spardDA । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 218 । 24 । “saMharzAdvArayan kroDaM DanvI srasvI raTasTitaH । samare nASayet SatrUnamoGo nAma pAvalaH ॥” vAyuH । iti viSvamedinyO ॥ (lomaharzaH । yaTA, suSrute । 6 । 6 । “dAhasaMharzatABratvaSokanistodagOravEH ॥”)
v: pu॰ samyak harzaH prA॰ sam + hfza--GaY vA । 1 Anande 2 spardDAvAYca saMhfzyatyanena karaRaM Dam । 3 pATo medi॰ ।
m: सं-हर्ष , ˚षण. See सम्-√ हृष्.
सं-हर्ष m. bristling or erection of the hair of the body, thrill of delight, joy, pleasure, MBh.; Śiś.
sexual excitement, Suśr.
ardour, emulation, rivalry, jealousy (cf. सं-घर्ष), MBh.; R. &c.
air, wind, L.
rubbing together, trituration (for संघर्ष), W.
a: संहर्षः — 1 Horripilation, a thrill of joy or fear. --2 Pleasure, joy, delight. --3 Emulation, rivalry. --4 Wind. --5 Rubbing together.

m: सं-˚हर्षण mf(ई)n. causing (the hair of the body) to stand erect (see लोम-ह्˚)
gladdening, delighting (with gen.), MBh.
सं-˚हर्षण n. emulation, rivalry, Kām.
सं-हर्ष—योगिन् mfn. possessing joy, enraptured, W.
सं-˚हर्षिन् mfn. thrilling with joy, gladdening, delighting (comp.), R.
envious, jealous, Śiś.
सं-˚हर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) bristling, standing erect (as the hair of the body), SaddhP.
सं-हत् f. (prob.) a layer, pile, RV. iii, 1, 7.
सं-ह˚ताङ्ग mfn. strong-limbed, well-knit, Suśr.
in close contiguity (as hills), MBh.
सं-ह˚ताश्व m. N. of a king (son of Nikumbha), Hariv.
सं-ह˚ताञ्जलि mfn. joining the hollowed hands (as a mark of supplication), Hariv.
सं-ह—तापन m. N. of a serpent-demon, MBh.
सं˚हती-भाव m. close union or connection, Car.,

s: tri, (saM + hana + ktaH .) dfQasanDiH । ityamaraH ॥ militaH । dfQaH । iti medinIkarahemacandrO ॥ samyakprakAreRa hataSca ॥
v: tri॰ sam + hana--kta । 1 dfQasanDO amaraH । 2 milite 3 dfQe medi॰ । 4 parArTaM milite “saMhaparArTatvAditi” sANKyasU॰ । 4 dfQasaMyogayukte 5 samyag hate ca । BAve kta । 6 saMGAte na॰ ।
m: सं-हत mfn. struck together, closely joined or united with (instr.), keeping together, contiguous, coherent, combined, compacted, forming one mass or body, ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
accompanied or attended by (instr.), Mn. vii, 165
become solid, compact, firm, hard, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
strong-limbed, athletic, MBh.
strong, intensive, VarBṛS.
(prob.) complex, composite, compound (said of a partic. tone and odour), MBh.
struck, hurt, wounded, killed, W.
सं-हत n. a partic. position in dancing, Saṃgīt.
a: संहत — p. p. 1 Struck together, wounded. --2 Closed, shut. --3 Wellknit, firmly united. --4 Closely joined or allied; Ki. 1. 19. --5 Compact, firm, solid. --6 Combined, joined, keeping together, being in a body, being very close; जालमादाय गच्छंति संहताः पक्षिणोऽप्यमी Pt. 2. 8; 5. 101; H. 1. 37. --7 Of one accord. --8 Assembled, collected. --Comp. --जानु a. knock-kneed. --भ्रू a. knitting the eyebrows. --स्तनी a woman whose breasts are very close to each other.

k.v: चञ्चलं तरलं च एव पारिप्लवपरिप्लवे। अतिरिक्तः समधिको धृढसन्धिस्तु संहतः॥

m: सं-हत—भ्रू mfn. knitting the brows, MBh.
सं-हत—भ्रूकुटि-मुख mfn. one on whose face the brows are contracted, ib.
सं-हत—हस्त mfn. seizing or holding each other by the hand (-त्व, n.), Gobh., Sch.
सं-हत—हस्त—त्व n.

s: tri, (saMhate jAnunI yasya .) lagnajAnukaH । yaTA, -- “prajYuH pragatajAnuH syAt prajYo'trEva ca dfSyate saMjYuH saMhatajAnuSca Bavet saMjYo'pi tatra hi । UrdDvajYu rUrdDvajAnuH syAdUrdDvajYo'pyUrdDvajAnukaH ॥” iti BarataDftasAhasANkaH ॥
v: tri॰ saMhade jAnunI yasya । lagnajAnuke amaraH vA kap । tatrArTe ।
m: सं-हत—जानु mfn. knock-kneed, L.

s: tri, (saMhatajAnureva । svArTe kan .) lagnajAnukaH । tatparyyAyaH । saMjYuH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ saMhatajAnuH 3 saMjYaH 4 । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥
m: सं-हत—जानुक mfn. knock-kneed, L.

k.v: खुरणाः स्यात्खुरणसः प्रज्ञुः प्रगतजानुकः। ऊर्ध्वज्ञुरूर्ध्वजानुः स्यात्संज्ञुः संहतजानुकः॥

m: सं-हत—कुलीन mfn. belonging to a family closely allied or related, ĀpŚr., Sch.

s: puM, (saMhataM parasparayormelanaM lAtIti । lA + kaH .) militapARidvayam । ityamaraH ॥ dvO vAmadakziRO pratalO saMhatO militO saMhatala ucyate । prataladDayaM militaM saMhatalaH । syAdityarTaH । saMhataM lAti saMhatalaH hanajanAditiqaH । nirvisargapAWe dvO vAmadakziRO pARI saMhatO militO cret tadA saMhatalapatalAvucyete । asminnarTe pratalo'yaM capewe saMhatale ca varttamAnatvAt nAnArTaH । iti BarataH ॥
v: pu॰ saM hataM saMhananaM saNgAtaM lAti--lA--ka । militapARidvaye amaraH ।
m: सं-ह—तल m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together, L. (cf. संहत- and संघ-त्)

k.v: द्वौ संहतौ संहतलप्रतलौ वामदक्षिणौ। पाणिर्निकुब्जः प्रसृतिस्तौ युतावञ्जलिः पुमान्.।

m: सं-हत—मूर्ति mfn. of compact form or shape, strong, intensive, VarBṛS.
सं-हत—पुच्छि ind. with contracted tail g. द्विदण्ड्य्-आदि

v: strI saMhatAni dvaQasaMyuktAni puzpARyuKAH kap ata ittvam । miSreyAyAM rAjani॰ ।

m: सं-हत—स्तनी f. a woman whose breasts are very close to each other, MW.
सं-हत—ता f. close contact or union, Śiś.
a: संहतता --त्वं — 1 Close contact, conjunction. --2 Compactness. --3 Agreement, union. --4 Harmony, concord.

m: सं-हत—तल m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together, W.
सं-हत—त्व n. id., Pañcat. (v.l.)
complexity, compactness, close combination, W.
सं-हत—वाक्-कल mfn. (du.) ‘joining the tones of the voice’, singing a duet, MārkP.
सं-हत—वृत्तोरु mfn. one who has round and firm thighs, R.

s: strI, (saM + hata + ktin .) samUhaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, hitopadeSe । “alpAnAmapi vastUnAM saMhatiH kAryyasADikA । tfRErguRatvamApannErvaDyante mattadantinaH ॥”)
v: strI sam + hana--ktin । 1 samUhe amaraH । 2 samyaghanane ca ।
m: संहति f. striking together, closure, Kāv.; ŚārṅgS.
compactness, solidity, MBh.; VarBṛS.
thickening, swelling, ŚārṅgS.
keeping together, saving, economy, Kāv.
firm union or alliance, junction, joint effort, close contact or connection with (instr.), Kāv.; Pur.; Rājat.
a seam, Kum.
a compact mass, bulk, heap, collection, multitude, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
a: संहतिः — f. 1 Firm or close contact, close union; Ku. 5. 8. --2 Union, combination; सहातिः कार्यसाधिका, संहतिः श्रेयसी पुंसां H. 1; cf. “Union is strength”. --3 Compactness, firmness, solidity. --4 Bulk, mass; गुरुतां नयंति हि गुणा न संहतिः Ki. 12. 10. --5 Agreement, harmony. --6 A collection, heap, assemblage, multitude; वनान्यवांचीव चकार संहतिः Ki. 14. 34, 27; 3. 20; 5. 4; Mu. 3. 2. --7 Strength. --8 The body.

k.v: समुदायः समुदयः समवायश्चयो गणः। स्त्रियां तु संहतिर्वृन्दं निकुरम्बं कदम्बकम्.।

m: संहति—शलिन् mfn. thick, dense, Śiś.
सं-ह˚तोरु mfn. firm-thighed, MBh.
सं˚हत्य ind. having struck or put together &c.
joined, combined together with (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं˚हत्य—कारिन् mfn. working together or with joined effort, BhP.
सं˚हत्य—कारि-ता f. common work or endeavour, KātyŚr.
सं˚हत्य—कारि-त्व n. common work or endeavour, KātyŚr.
सं-हवन See सं-√ हु.
सं-हवन n. the act of sacrificing together or in a proper manner, MW.
a quadrangle, group of four houses, L.

m: सं-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to bring or draw together, unite, compress, collect, contract, abridge, RV. &c. &c.; to throw together, mix up, ŚrS.; to close, clench (the fist), MBh.; to concentrate (the mind) on (loc.), ib.; to support, maintain, Jātakam.; to take or fetch from (abl.), R.; to lay hold of, attract, take for one's self, appropriate, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to take away, carry off, rob, AitBr.; MBh.; to lay or draw aside, withdraw, withhold from (abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to restrain, curb, check, suppress, ib. ; to crush together, crumple up, destroy, annihilate (often opp. to √ सृज्, ‘to emit or create’), Up.; MBh. &c.; Pass. -ह्रियते, to be brought or put together &c., MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -हारयति, ˚ते, to bind t˚ (Ā. ‘one's own hair &c.’, also ‘cut’), GṛŚrS.; Car. : -जिहीर्षति, to wish to bring together &c., ŚBr. : Intens. -जरीहर्ति, to destroy repeatedly, Cat.
a: संहृ — {c1c} P. (sometimes A. also) 1 To bring or draw together. --2 To draw out, suck; Pt. 1. 221. --3 (a) To contract, abridge, compress; महिमानं यदुत्कीर्त्य तव संह्रि ते वचः R. 10. 30. (b) To drop; संह्रियतामियं K. --4 To bring together, collect, accumulate. --5 To destroy, annihilate (opp. सृज्): अमुं युगांतोचितकालनिद्रः संहृत्य लाकान् पुरुषोऽधिशेते R. 13. 6. --6 To withdraw, withhold draw or take back; अभिमुखे मयि संहृतमीक्षितं Ś. 2. 11; 6. 3; न हि संहरते ज्योत्स्नां चंद्रश्चांडालवेश्मनि H. 1. 61; R. 4. 16; 12. 103. --7 To curb, restrain, suppress; क्रोधं प्रभो संहर संहरेति यावद्गिरः खे मरुतां चरंति Ku. 3. 72. --8 To wind up, close. --9 To seize, take. --10 To unite, bind by obligations.

सं-√ हृष् P. -हृष्यति (mc. also Ā. ˚ते), to bristle, stand erect (as the hair of the body from joy or fright), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to thrill with delight, be glad, rejoice, ib. : Caus. -हर्षयति, to gladden, delight, R.; Divyāv.
a: संहृष् — {c4c} P. 1 To be glad, rejoice, thrill with delight. --2 To bristle, stand on end (as hair).

thrilled, delighted, glad, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
flaming briskly (as fire), R.
a: संहृष्ट — p. p. 1 Thrilled or horripilated with joy, delighted. --2 Bristling, shuddering. --3 Fired with emulation.

s: strI, samyak (DIyate smeti । DA + karmmaRi ktaH । yadDA samyak hitaM pratipAdyaM yasyAH .) manvAdipraRItaDarmmaSAstram । tatparyyAyaH । smftiH 2 DarmmasaMhitA 3 SrutijIvikA 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ saMhitAviSezA yaTA, -- “evaM purARasaMKyAnaM caturlakzamudAhftam । azwAdaSapurARAnAmevameva vidurbuDAH । evaYcopapurARAnAmazwAdaSa prakIrttitAH ॥ itihAso BArataYca vAlmIkaM kAvyameva ca । paYcakaM paYcarAtrARAM kfzRamAhAtsyamuttamam ॥ vASizWaM nAradIyaYca kApilaM gOtamIyakam । paraM sanatkumArIyaM paYcarAtraYca paYcakam । paYcamyaH sahitAnAYca kfzRaBaktisamanvitAH । bragmaRaSca SivasyApi prahrAdasya taTEva ca । gOtamasya kumArasya saMhitAH parikIrttitAH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte SrIkfzRajanmaKaRqe 132 aDyAyaH ॥ api ca । “idantu paYcadaSamaM purARaM kOrmmamuttamam ॥ caturDA saMsTitaM puRyaM saMhitAnAM praBedataH ॥ brAhmI BAgavatI SEvI vEzRavI ca prakIrttitA । catasraH saMhitAH puRyA DarmmakAmArTamokzadAH ॥ iyantu saMhitA brAhmI caturvvedEH samanyitA । Bavanti zawsahasrARi SlokAnAmatra saMKyayA ॥” iti kOrmme 1 aDyAyaH ॥ tatra skandapurARoktazawsaMhitA yaTA, -- “skAndamadyABivakzyAmi purARaM Srutisammitam । zaqviDaM saMhitABedEH paYcASatKaRqamaRqitam ॥ AdyA sanatkumAroktA dvitIyA sUtasaMhitA । tftIyA SANkarI viprAScaturTI vEzRavI matA ॥ tatparA saMhitA brAhmI sOrAntyA saMhitA matA । granTataH paYcapaYcASatsahasreRopalakzitA ॥ AdyA tu saMhitA viprA dvitIyA zawsahasrikA । tftIyA granTatastriMSat sahasreRopalakzitA । turIyA saMhitA paYcasahasreRopalakzitA । tato'nnA trisahasreRa granTenEva vinirmmitA । anyA sahasrataH sfzwA granTataH paRqitottamAH ॥” iti skandapurARe sUtasaMhitAyAM SivamAhAtmyaKaRqe 1 aDyAyaH ॥
v: strI samyak hitaM pratizAdyaM yasyAH । 1 manvAdipraRIte DarmaSAstre 2 purARe 3 itihAsAdO 4 karmakARqapratipAdake vedaBAge ca saMhitApAWaprakArastu ti॰ ta॰ matsyasUktoktaH caRqISabde 2850 pf॰ darSitaH । “paraH sannikarzaH sahitA” pA॰ ukte 5 pUrvAparavarRayoH atyantasannikarze tatra niyamaviSezaH sparyyate “saMhitEkapate nityA nityA DAtUpasargayoH । nityA samAse vAkye tu sA vivakzAmapekzate” ।
m: सं-हिता (आ), f., see next
सं-हिता f. conjunction, connection, union, TUp.
(in gram.) the junction or combination of letters according to euphonic rules (= संधि, but sometimes considered rather as the state preparatory to the actual junction than the junction itself), Prāt.

a text treated according to euphonic rules (esp. the real continuous text of the Vedas as formed out of the Padas or separate words by proper phonetic changes [according to various schools; cf. IW. 152] : beside the Saṃhitās of the Ṛg-, Sāma-, and Atharvaveda there is the Vājasaneyi-Saṃhitā belonging to the White Yajur-veda, and five other Saṃhitās belonging to the black Yajur-veda, viz. the Taittirīya-S˚, the Saṃhitā of the Ātreyas [known only by its Anukramaṇī], the S˚ of the Kaṭhas, the Kapiṣṭhala-Kaṭha-S˚, and the S˚ of the Maitrāyaṇīyas or Maitrāyaṇī-S˚), Nir.; Prāt. &c.

any methodically arranged collection of texts or verses (e.g. the Rāmāyaṇa, the various law-books, the medical works of Caraka and Śārṅgadhara, the complete system of natural astrology &c. [cf. बृहत्-स्˚]; there is also a Saṃhitā of the Purāṇas said to have been compiled by Vyāsa, the substance of which is supposed to be represented by the Viṣṇu-purāṇa), MBh.; VarBṛS.; Pur. &c.
science, L.
the force which holds together and supports the universe (a term applied to the Supreme Being accord. to some), MW.
N. of various works.
a: संहिता — 1 Combination, union, conjunction. --2 A collection, compilation, compendium. --3 Any systematically arranged collection of texts or verses. --4 A compendium or compilation of laws, code, digest; मनुसंहिता. --5 The continuous hymnical text of the Veda as formed out of the Padas or individual words by proper phonetic changes according to different Śākhās or schools; पदप्रकृतिः सहिता Nir. --6 (In gram) Compination or junction of letters according to the rules of Saṃdhi or euphony; परः संनिकर्षः संहिता P. I. 4. 109; वर्णानामतिशयितः संनिधिः संहितासंज्ञः स्यात् Sk.; or वर्णानामे कप्राणयोगः संहिता. --7 The Supreme Being who hold and supports the universe. --Comp. --पाठः the continuous text of the Veda (opp. पदपाठ q. v.).

a: संहित — p. p. 1 Placed together, joined, united. --2 Agreeing with, conformable to, in accordance with. --3 Relating to. --4 Collected. --5 Provided, furnished, endowed, accompanied. --6 Caused by. --7 Placed, fixed. --8 Compiled; see संधा.

सं-˚ह्रादिन् m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
